title: On the True Faith, to the Princesses Arcadia and Marina
edition: Pusey, Sancti patris nostri Cyrilli archiepiscopi Alexandrini De recta fide ad reginas (Oxford, 1877)
blurb: Cyril’s court treatise on right faith for Arcadia and Marina (CPG 5219). One Son, Word made flesh — not two Christs. English from Pusey’s Greek.
first_english_note: This court treatise has had no freely usable complete English for modern readers. The English here is new from Pusey’s Greek.

text_history.method: English follows Pusey’s 1877 Greek of De recta fide ad Arcadiam et Marinam. OCR of that print was cleaned section by section before Pass A/B. This is a reading translation for study, not a new critical edition.

witnesses.name: Pusey, De recta fide ad reginas (Oxford, 1877)
